read.thesis: Q3 sales up 61% to $4,313M with organic orders up over 100%; FY26 sales guide raised $650M to $14.65B midpoint, but capacity expansion and working-capital build (inventory +$767M in quarter) are rising alongside.

capex.quote: Capital expenditures for full year 2026 are still anticipated at approximately 4.0% of revenue, reflecting the continued investment Vertiv is making to capture increasing demand across its pipelines.

triggers.label: Organic orders growth over 100%
triggers.quote: Our more than 100% organic orders growth year over year and our overall performance are clear testaments to that.

triggers.label: FY26 net sales guide raised $650M
triggers.quote: give Vertiv the confidence to raise full year net sales guidance by $650 million

triggers.label: Capex ~4.0% of revenue held

guidance.quote: raise full year net sales guidance by $650 million

red_flags.label: Working capital build; inventory up $767M in Q3
red_flags.quote: Third quarter adjusted free cash flow was driven by higher adjusted operating profit partially offset by increased working capital and higher capital expenditures to support growth.
